results.title: After Deepika Padukone’s exit, Katrina Kaif to join Prabhas in Spirit? Here’s what we know - Pinkvilla
results.description: After Deepika Padukone’s exit, Katrina Kaif to join Prabhas in Spirit? Here’s what we know  PinkvillaKatrina Kaif To Join Prabhas-Starrer Spirit After Deepika Padukone's Exit? Here's What We Know  NDTVKatrina Kaif In Prabhas Film? Deets Inside  Tupaki EnglishRumours Abound: Katrina Kaif in Talks for Prabhas' Spirit?  Deccan ChronicleWill Katrina Kaif star in Prabhas's upcoming film Spirit?  Udayavani
results.content:
Filmmaker Sandeep Reddy Vanga's upcoming action thriller Spirit stars pan-India star Prabhas in a fierce avatar, and has been making buzz ever since its inception. Now, the latest update suggests that Bollywood star Katrina Kaif is in talks to join the high-profile project. Read on!

Ever since Deepika Padukone's much-discussed exit from Spirit has seen major developments. While Triptii Dimri was later reported to have stepped in as the female lead opposite Prabhas, fresh industry reports suggest that there has been an addition of a major actor who will be making a special appearance.

According to Deccan Herald, makers are considering Katrina Kaif for a crucial, high-impact cameo or an extended special appearance in the film. Sources close to the development hint that although Katrina’s screen time might be brief, her character arrives at a critical turning point in the narrative, making it one of the major surprise elements of the movie.

If these reports materialize, Spirit will mark a major milestone in Katrina Kaif’s impressive filmography. It would officially mark her return to Telugu cinema after nearly 21 years. She is also remembered from her early Tollywood days when she starred in blockbusters like Malliswari alongside Venkatesh and Allari Pidugu alongside Nandamuri Balakrishna.

Given that the actress has been selective with her film choices over the last few years, seeing her share screen space with Prabhas would undeniably be a cinematic treat for fans.

As of now, neither Katrina Kaif nor the makers of Spirit have officially confirmed any of these reports. Everything remains strictly a speculation.

With Spirit already progressing rapidly through its production schedules ahead of its grand theatrical release, an official announcement from the production house is still awaited.
